mission.title: alertmanager: Send subsequent notifications to a slack thread instead of channel
mission.description: Send subsequent notifications to a slack thread instead of channel. Requested by 54+ users.

steps.title: Check current alertmanager deployment
steps.description:
Verify your alertmanager version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/name=alertmanager
helm list -n alertmanager 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working alertmanager installation.

steps.title: Review alertmanager configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant alertmanager configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/name=alertmanager
kubectl get configmap -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=alertmanager
```
**What did you do?**

Currently alertmanager would send an alert & resolve alert in the same way as a new message.

steps.title: Apply the fix for Send subsequent notifications to a slack thread instead of…
steps.description:
While the feature request makes sense (and not only for Slack, see https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/issues/3202), we have no easy way right now to implement this because in a multi-node setup, the subsequent notification might be sent by a different Alertmanager node which wouldn't know the thread id.
To circumvent the problem, it would require to add the thread id to the notification logs. If we were to go this route, it should be done in an extensible way so it can be applied to all

See the source issue for community-verified solutions.

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n alertmanager -l app.kubernetes.io/name=alertmanager
kubectl get events -n alertmanager --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "Send subsequent notifications to a slack thread instead of…" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: While the feature request makes sense (and not only for Slack, see https://github.com/prometheus/alertmanager/issues/3202), we have no easy way right now to implement this because in a multi-node setup, the subsequent notification might be sent by a different Alertmanager node which wouldn't know the thread id.

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with alertmanager installed or the issue environment reproducible.
